title: _safePay revert on unstake forces principal-retention hazard
description: If balance < pending at unstake time, _safePay reverts the whole call, blocking principal withdrawal. Users must fall back to emergencyWithdraw, forfeiting accrued rewards. Reward shortfall is coupled to principal exit.
remediation: Split the payout so principal always returns; pay rewards best-effort or queue residual as unclaimed dust.
